test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In this question, two statements are followed by four conclusions given as options. Decide which conclusion is definitely true, based on the given statements.

Statements:

P ≤ Q S > V ≥ W
solution:
Given Statement: 

P ≤ Q S > V ≥ W

Now,

Conclusions:

1. P → False (P ≤ Q V ≥ W No relation can be established between P and V)

2. R > W → False (P ≤ Q > V ≥ W No relation can be established between R and W)

3. Q → False (P ≤ Q > V ≥ W No relation can be established between Q and W)

4.** P → True (P ≤ Q It gives P T)**

Here, Conclusions 4 follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
